Our team will assess your home or building and recommend the best ducting solution for your system, budget, and layout — no guesswork, just honest advice.
groups.imageAlt: Sheet metal ventilation ducts branching out under a steel roof

services.title: Duct Repair / Replacement
services.text: Seal and restore your ductwork for improved air quality and energy efficiency throughout your home. Leaky ducts waste energy — we fix them fast.

services.title: R-8 Flexible Duct
services.text: R-8 flexible duct is the most widely used residential ducting solution in the Greater Houston area. Its pre-insulated, double-layer construction meets and exceeds Texas energy code requirements, while its flexibility makes it ideal for navigating the tight attic spaces and complex framing found in most Houston-area homes.
points: R-8 insulation rating — exceeds Texas energy code requirements
Flexible routing around framing, joists, and attic obstacles
Pre-insulated from the factory — no extra wrap needed
Lightweight and fast to install — lower labor cost
Ideal for residential attic and crawlspace runs
Available in standard diameters from 4" to 20"
Better thermal performance than older R-6 flex duct, reducing heat gain in hot attics

services.title: Sheet Metal Ductwork
services.text: Custom fabricated from galvanized steel to the exact dimensions of your system, sheet metal maintains its shape permanently, delivering consistent, unrestricted airflow from the air handler to every register in the building. When properly sealed with mastic or foil tape, sheet metal ducts are virtually airtight.
points: Custom fabricated to exact dimensions for your system
Maximum airflow efficiency — no compression or sag
Superior air sealing with mastic or foil tape
Extremely long lifespan — outlasts the HVAC equipment
Ideal for long straight runs and high-static systems
Required for many commercial and new construction builds

groups.title: Air Quality Control

groups.imageAlt: A UV-C sanitization lamp of the kind fitted inside an HVAC system

services.title: UV Light Sanitization

services.title: HEPA Filtration

services.title: Whole-Home Air Purifier

services.title: Humidity Control

tiers.name: Spring AC Tune-Up
features: Clean interior of condensing unit, remove debris
Clean outdoor condenser coil fins
Inspect & balance condenser fan blade
Test condenser fan motor amperage
Inspect compressor amperage vs. nameplate
Test capacitor performance to rating
Check & tighten all electrical connections
Inspect & clean blower assembly and wheel
Clean evaporator coil
Flush condensate drain with nitrogen
Install algaecide tablets in drain pan
Check refrigerant charge — superheat & subcooling
Measure temperature drop across indoor coil
Visual inspection for refrigerant leaks
Check, clean & test thermostat operation

tiers.name: Fall / Winter Heating Service
features: Confirm furnace fires off safely at peak efficiency
Inspect heat exchanger integrity — verify no combustion gas crossover
Confirm all combustion gases venting properly outdoors
If condensing furnace: inspect condensate drain, trap & inlet screen
Inspect & tighten all high and low voltage heating circuits
Test igniter and flame sensor
Verify draft switch and pressure switch operation
Calibrate thermostat — verify accurate temperature control
Lubricate all moving parts to reduce wear
Assess ductwork for leaks or blockages
Measure temperature rise across heating assembly — confirm vs. manufacturer specs
Run full system test for optimal performance

plan.note: Refrigerant top-off is quoted separately if needed. Most visits take 60 to 90 minutes. Prices are per system. The AC tune-up is recommended before summer and the heating service before the first cold snap.

faqs.q: How often should I service my AC unit?
faqs.a: We recommend servicing your AC unit at least once a year, ideally in the spring before the cooling season begins. Regular maintenance helps prevent breakdowns, improves efficiency, and extends the life of your system.

faqs.q: What are signs that my AC needs repair?
faqs.a: Common signs include: warm air blowing from vents, unusual noises (grinding, squealing), high humidity indoors, frequent cycling on/off, water leaks around the unit, and unusually high energy bills.

faqs.q: How long does an AC unit typically last?
faqs.a: A well-maintained central air conditioning system typically lasts 15-20 years. Regular maintenance can significantly extend this lifespan, while neglect can shorten it considerably.

faqs.q: What size AC unit do I need?
faqs.a: The right size depends on your home's square footage, insulation, ceiling height, and local climate. An undersized unit will run constantly without cooling properly, while an oversized unit will short-cycle. Our technicians will perform a proper load calculation.

items: Xpress obtains all permits necessary for the work at its own expense

Progress is communicated at the end of each work day by text or email

facts.heading: What a warranty visit covers
items: Primary components under review — compressor, condenser, furnace primary components, evaporator and air-handler primary components required for operation, subject to inspection and your written agreement
Secondary components not covered — contactors, capacitors, refrigerant recharges, drain pans, overflow switches, thermostats and similar auxiliary parts
Warranty requests are reserved for work Xpress completed; work another company did is handled as a new service request
Work performed by third-party contractors voids the warranty, and named or unnamed storms, damage, vandalism and other non-manufacture defects are excluded
A maintenance or tune-up visit is handled as a service request rather than a warranty claim

facts.heading: Payment and billing
items: Change orders are paid in full on approval, and work on them starts once payment is received
Xpress may apply up to a 48-hour payment processing period for funds and material verification, communicated by phone, text or email
A missed scheduled payment pauses all work, including correction work, until payment is received
Lien releases or waivers are provided on request once full and final payment is received

facts.heading: Disputes

facts.heading: Cancellation
facts.text: Letting Xpress begin the proposed service before the end of the three business day window forfeits the right to cancel the agreement, and the full amount in the agreement is owed on completion.

facts.heading: Text messages
facts.text: Transactional and marketing text messages are sent only with your consent at the number you provide, message frequency varies, and replying STOP opts you out.

facts.heading: Why ductwork matters
items: Up to 30% of energy is lost through leaky or uninsulated ducts
Proper sizing ensures balanced airflow and consistent comfort room to room
Sealed ducts improve indoor air quality by keeping dust and allergens out

facts.heading: Why seasonal maintenance matters
items: Regular tune-ups can add years to an HVAC system's lifespan
A clean, calibrated system runs more efficiently, often cutting energy costs by 10 to 15%
Catching small issues before summer heat or winter cold avoids costly emergency calls
Many manufacturer warranties require documented annual maintenance to stay valid
